verdicts.reason: A moves the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. It also mixes a left-aligned text block with a centred bottle and CTA, leaves 'sparkling.' orphaned on its own line, and wastes space at the top. Even so, every element is whole and the hierarchy still works. B keeps the original reading order but crops the bottle's base off the bottom edge, jams an oversized, nearly full-width CTA right under the body copy, and moves the circle to the bottom corner, where it reads as an afterthought. The layout looks cramped at the top and cut off at the bottom.
